title: Crystal ball with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ornamental stand base -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="90" rx="30" ry="8" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <rect x="28" y="82" width="44" height="8" rx="3" fill="#A0692E"/>
  <!-- Stand neck -->
  <rect x="40" y="75" width="20" height="10" rx="3" fill="#C49A4A"/>
  <!-- Orb shadow/glow -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="34" fill="#1A3A5A"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="33" fill="#2E6FA0"/>
  <!-- Orb main body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="30" fill="#3FA9D9"/>
  <!-- Crystal facets -->
  <path d="M50 18 L62 36 L50 48 L38 36 Z" fill="#7ED4F5" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M50 48 L62 36 L78 50 L64 62 Z" fill="#5BC0E8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M50 48 L38 36 L22 50 L36 62 Z" fill="#5BC0E8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <path d="M50 48 L64 62 L50 78 L36 62 Z" fill="#4AA8D0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Highlight gleam -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="32" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#B8EEFF" opacity="0.7" transform="rotate(-30 38 32)"/>
  <!-- Smiling face on orb -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="44" r="3.5" fill="#F5F0C0"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="44" r="3.5" fill="#F5F0C0"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="43" r="1.5" fill="#1A3A5A"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="43" r="1.5" fill="#1A3A5A"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M39 54 Q50 65 61 54" stroke="#F5F0C0" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="52" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FF8FA3" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="52" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FF8FA3" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Bottom glow reflection -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="12" ry="4" fill="#7ED4F5" opacity="0.3"/>
</svg>
